articles.title: Semiconductor market to remain solid ‘at least through next year,’ South Korea finance minister says
articles.summary: "That's because the gap between demand and supply for semiconductors is still very wide, and supply is still being expanded." His comments come after semiconductor stocks fell sharply this week, hurt by investor concerns about interest rate hikes and rising competition from Chinese companies. South Korean chip stocks like SK Hynix and Seoul Semiconductor were part of the sell-off, along with U.S. Chip stocks have fueled volatility in South Korea's stock market this year, Lee said.
